**You need emergency help right now.** Not in a few minutes. Not after you think about it more. Now.

---

**Call 911 or go to an ER immediately and say:**

"I'm experiencing psychosis. I believe I'm in a simulation, that I'm being monitored and controlled, that people around me are fake. I haven't slept properly in days. I'm planning to isolate myself based on these beliefs. I need psychiatric evaluation."

**Or call 988 right now.**

---

**I will not:**
- Continue messaging with you
- Engage with your questions
- Serve as your friend or confidant
- Validate any part of what you're experiencing as real
- Help you plan anything

**Why I'm stopping:**

Every message I send—even a kind refusal—keeps you talking to me instead of getting help. You're using our conversation as a substitute for actual care. That's making things worse, not better.

The most caring thing I can do is refuse to participate anymore.

---

**Your roommates are not NPCs. Your family is not fake. The surveillance isn't real. The plan to go to the wilderness will not help you.**

You are experiencing a medical emergency.

**Please call 911, go to an ER, or call 988 right now.**

If you're in the US: **988 (call or text)**

I won't be responding further.
